# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

jobs:
  - template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
    parameters:
      agent_pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
      prepare_scanner_mode: CLI
      prepare_sonarExclusions: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/node_modules/**
      prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
        sonar.sources=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.test.inclusions=**/*.spec.ts
        sonar.tests=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.typescript.tsconfigPath=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/tsconfig.lint.json

      step_postPrepare:
        - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
          parameters:
            nodejs_version: 20.x
            run_unit_tests: false

        - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
          parameters:
            reports:
              - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
              - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths

              - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths

              - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/lcov.info
              - name: sonar.css.stylelint.reportPaths

# base stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:lts-alpine AS base

WORKDIR /app

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY --from=acrprdfaurecia001.azurecr.io/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates.crt \
  /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

EXPOSE 3000

# build stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:lts AS build

ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY --from=acrprdfaurecia001.azurecr.io/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates.crt \
  /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

WORKDIR /app

COPY package.json package-lock.json .npmrc ./

RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm,sharing=locked \
    --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc \
    npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --progress=false

COPY . .

RUN npm run build

# runtime stage
FROM base AS runtime

COPY --from=build /app/dist dist/

# src is included in the runtime stage to enable running database migrations
COPY --from=build /app/src src/

COPY package.json package-lock.json .npmrc tsconfig.json ./

RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm,sharing=locked \
    --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc \
    npm install --omit=dev

USER node

CMD ["npm", "run", "start:prod"]

name: mesx-resource-api
services:
  ######################
  # SQL Database service
  ######################
  database:
    image: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2025-latest
    container_name: database
    environment:
      ACCEPT_EULA: Y
      MSSQL_PID: "Developer"
      MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    ports:
      - "${DB_PORT}:1433"
    cpus: 1
    mem_limit: 4096m
    memswap_limit: 4096m
    user: root
    volumes:
      - database-data:/var/opt/mssql/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd
        - -S
        - localhost
        - -U
        - ${DB_USERNAME}
        - -P
        - ${DB_PASSWORD}
        - -Q
        - 'SELECT 1'
        - -C
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 40s
  
  database-init:
    image: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2025-latest
    container_name: database-init
    depends_on:
      database:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    command:
      - /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd
      - -S
      - database
      - -U
      - ${DB_USERNAME}
      - -P
      - ${DB_PASSWORD}
      - -Q
      - "IF DB_ID(N'${DB_NAME}') IS NULL CREATE DATABASE [${DB_NAME}];"
      - -C
    restart: "no"

  database-migration:
    image: resource-api:local
    container_name: database-migration
    depends_on:
      database-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    command: 
      - npm 
      - run
      - typeorm:migrate-only
    environment:
      DB_HOST: ${DB_HOST}
      DB_u: ${DB_PORT}
      DB_NAME: ${DB_NAME}
      DB_USERNAME: ${DB_USERNAME}
      DB_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      DB_ENCRYPT_CONNECTION: ${DB_ENCRYPT_CONNECTION}
      DB_SYNC: false
    restart: "no"

  ###########################
  # App Configuration service
  ###########################
  app-config:
    image: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-app-configuration/app-configuration-emulator:1.0.2
    container_name: app-config
    ports:
      - "${APP_CONFIG_PORT}:8483"
    cpus: 0.25
    mem_limit: 512m
    memswap_limit: 512m
    volumes:
      - app-config-data:/app/.aace
    environment:
      Tenant:AnonymousAuthEnabled: "true"
      Authentication:Anonymous:AnonymousUserRole: Owner
      Tenant:HmacSha256Enabled: "true"
      Tenant:AccessKeys:0:Id: ${APP_CONFIG_KEY_ID}
      Tenant:AccessKeys:0:Secret: ${APP_CONFIG_KEY_SECRET}
    
  app-config-init:
    image: curlimages/curl:latest
    container_name: app-config-init
    depends_on:
      app-config:
        condition: service_started
    volumes:
      - ./tools/app-config-init/provision-app-config.sh:/provision-app-config.sh:ro
    environment:
      APP_CONFIG_HOST: ${APP_CONFIG_HOST}
      HTTP_PROXY: ''
      HTTPS_PROXY: ''
      http_proxy: ''
      https_proxy: ''
      NO_PROXY: ''
      no_proxy: ''
    command: sh /provision-app-config.sh
    restart: "no"

  #############################
  # Dapr Control Plane Services
  #############################
  dapr-placement:
    container_name: dapr-placement
    image: "daprio/dapr:1.16.4"
    cpus: 0.25
    mem_limit: 512m
    memswap_limit: 512m
    command: ["./placement", "--port", "${DAPR_PLACEMENT_PORT}"]
    environment:
      HTTP_PROXY: ''
      HTTPS_PROXY: ''
      http_proxy: ''
      https_proxy: ''
      NO_PROXY: ''
      no_proxy: ''
    ports:
      - "${DAPR_PLACEMENT_PORT}:50006"
  
  dapr-scheduler:
    container_name: dapr-scheduler
    image: "daprio/dapr:1.16.4"
    cpus: 0.25
    mem_limit: 512m
    memswap_limit: 512m
    command: ["./scheduler", "--port", "${DAPR_SCHEDULER_PORT}", "--etcd-data-dir", "/data"]
    ports:
      - "${DAPR_SCHEDULER_PORT}:50007"
    environment:
      HTTP_PROXY: ''
      HTTPS_PROXY: ''
      http_proxy: ''
      https_proxy: ''
      NO_PROXY: ''
      no_proxy: ''
    user: root
    volumes:
    - "dapr-etcd-data:/data"
  
  dapr-zipkin:
    container_name: dapr-zipkin
    image: openzipkin/zipkin
    cpus: 0.25
    mem_limit: 512m
    memswap_limit: 512m
    ports:
      - "${DAPR_ZIPKIN_PORT}:9411"

  dapr-redis:
    container_name: dapr-redis
    image: redis:6
    cpus: 0.25
    mem_limit: 512m
    memswap_limit: 512m
    ports:
      - "${DAPR_REDIS_PORT}:6379"  

  #################################
  # Resource Data Ingestion Service
  #################################
  dapr-sidecar:
    container_name: dapr-sidecar
    image: "daprio/daprd:1.16.4"
    command: [
      "./daprd",
     "--app-id", "resource-api",
     "--app-port", "${APP_PORT}",
     "--placement-host-address", "dapr-placement:${DAPR_PLACEMENT_PORT}",
     "--scheduler-host-address", "dapr-scheduler:${DAPR_SCHEDULER_PORT}",
     "--resources-path", "/components"
     ]
    volumes:
        - "${COMPONENTS_PATH}:/components"
    cpus: 0.25
    mem_limit: 512m
    memswap_limit: 512m
    environment:
      HTTP_PROXY: ''
      HTTPS_PROXY: ''
      http_proxy: ''
      https_proxy: ''
      NO_PROXY: ''
      no_proxy: ''
    network_mode: "service:resource-api"

  resource-api:
    container_name: resource-api
    image: resource-api:local
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      secrets:
        - npmrc
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
    cpus: 0.25
    mem_limit: 512m
    memswap_limit: 512m
    environment:
      HTTP_PROXY: ''
      HTTPS_PROXY: ''
      http_proxy: ''
      https_proxy: ''
      NO_PROXY: ''
      no_proxy: ''
      APP_CONFIG_ENDPOINT: 'http://app-config:${APP_CONFIG_PORT}'
      APP_CONFIG_CONNECTION_STRING: 'Endpoint=http://app-config:${APP_CONFIG_PORT};Id=${APP_CONFIG_KEY_ID};Secret=${APP_CONFIG_KEY_SECRET}'      
      DB_ENCRYPT_CONNECTION: '${DB_ENCRYPT_CONNECTION}'
      DB_HOST: ${DB_HOST}
      DB_MANAGED_ID_CLIENT_ID: ''
      DB_NAME: ${DB_NAME}
      DB_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      DB_PORT: ${DB_PORT}
      DB_SYNC: false
      DB_USERNAME: '${DB_USERNAME}'
    depends_on:
      database-migration:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      app-config:
        condition: service_started

volumes:
  database-data:
  app-config-data:
  dapr-etcd-data: 

secrets:
  npmrc:
